_description: Registry of Schema.org types evaluated during structured-data-audit. Defines required and recommended properties, applicable page contexts, and citation-readiness impact for AI agents.

Organization.ai_impact: Grounds brand name, canonical homepage URL, brand logo, and authoritative cross-platform profiles (sameAs) for AI citation.

WebSite.ai_impact: Enables search engine site links and Sitelinks Search Box; disambiguates site scope.

LocalBusiness.ai_impact: Essential for localized AI queries ('find nearby...', 'is X open today?'); grounds physical presence and NAP.

Product.ai_impact: Directly fuels AI purchase recommendations, price comparisons, and feature lookups. Without Offer, price is invisible.

Offer.ai_impact: Supplies exact cost and currency directly to AI assistants; prevents hallucinated or stale pricing answers.

Article.ai_impact: Provides publication chronology and authorship credentials; AI uses dateModified for freshness evaluation.

BlogPosting.ai_impact: Signals informal article publication date and authorship attribution.

NewsArticle.ai_impact: Critical for real-time and current event synthesis by AI models.

FAQPage.ai_impact: Highest-leverage markup for direct question answering and zero-click extraction in AI assistants.

BreadcrumbList.ai_impact: Communicates hierarchical parent-child context and site taxonomy to crawler graphs.

SoftwareApplication.ai_impact: Clarifies platform compatibility (macOS, Windows, iOS, Web) and pricing for technical software solutions.

Service.ai_impact: Labels capability offerings, target geography, and providing legal entity.

anti_patterns.name: Invalid nesting or unquoted JSON
anti_patterns.description: JSON-LD block cannot be parsed by standard JSON decoders.

anti_patterns.name: Placeholders or dummy content
anti_patterns.description: Schema properties contain placeholders such as 'Lorem ipsum', 'example.com', 'Acme', or 'TODO'.

anti_patterns.name: Content mismatch with visible DOM
anti_patterns.description: Values declared in schema (e.g. price, product name) contradict visible content on the rendered page.
